description:
The Sanitas Pistil Trail is handcrafted using hand-selected, size-specific, cold-worked 3/2.5 titanium tubing. Each frame is designed and built one by one in our Durango, Colorado, facility to provide a ride specifically catered to the customer’s riding style and needs.

Designed around hand-picked, oversized, cold-worked, stress-relieved titanium tubing, a hydroformed downtube, and an independent CNC’d 7075-R aluminum rear triangle. The Pistil trail is our first offering in the trail bike market. This bike is tailored for the trail rider, from all-mountain trails and town laps to days in the bike park centered around a generous 150mm of dual-suspension travel. The rear triangle utilizes the 3VO suspension designed by Chris Curry at Ministry Cycles and a Titanium 3D-printed yoke for the seat tube and bearing mounts. The front triangle uses a hydroformed downtube to provide ample shock clearance and increased strength. Rider position and preference can be tailored through custom geometry, which is all done in-house. The Pistil Trail’s design has been optimized to provide ample tire clearance of 29 x 2.6”, so you get that smooth ride over all types of terrain.

Each frame is offered with custom geometry at no additional charge. Please reach out for a custom geometry fit sheet.

The customization does not stop with your frame geometry or finish! Drivetrain and components are just as personal as your riding style! With the ability to hand-select the components of your choice, you have 100% say in building out the bike of your dreams. Complete bike builds are quoted upon request and individualized for each rider.
